text:
```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-cdk-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install yq

      - name: Update CDK version
        run: |
          yq e '.baseImage = "source-declarative-manifest:7.6.5"' -i airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml
          sed -i 's/version: 4\.4\.18/version: 4\.4\.19/' airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml
          echo "- Updated CDK version to 7.6.5" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md
          git commit -m "chore(source-gitlab): Update CDK version from 7.6.1 to 7.6.5"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
```
